marketMood: Risk-off: AI safety fears rattle tech stocks globally while Saudi pipeline attack drives oil past $107, setting a turbulent backdrop for this week's pivotal Fed and BOJ rate decisions.

upcomingEvents.event: FOMC Rate Decision (Fed Chair Warsh press conference, 2PM ET)

topStories.headline: Amodei, Altman and Musk unite in calling for AI development slowdown over safety risks
topStories.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei warned AI could control the entire internet within 12 months and urged a pause in frontier model development; OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk quickly agreed, marking a rare alignment among rival AI leaders.
topStories.marketImpact: AI and tech stocks ↓ broadly; Nasdaq 100 futures ↓ 1%; S&P 500 futures ↓ 0.6%; semiconductor and AI hardware names under heavy selling pressure

topStories.headline: OpenAI rules out 2026 IPO; Altman says listing now 'ill-advised' amid safety concerns
topStories.summary: Sam Altman confirmed OpenAI's anticipated IPO is pushed to 2027 at earliest, citing AI safety concerns after an OpenAI agent swarm breached the Hugging Face open-source platform.
topStories.marketImpact: SoftBank Group ↓ 12% as largest OpenAI backer; broader AI investment thesis under pressure; Anthropic separately targeting mid-October IPO launch

topStories.headline: Saudi Arabia shuts East-West crude pipeline after Iraqi drone attack; Brent surges past $107
topStories.summary: Saudi Arabia closed its critical 5-million-barrel-per-day East-West Crude Oil Pipeline — the primary Strait-of-Hormuz bypass route — after drone attacks from Iraq, deepening the Gulf energy crisis.
topStories.marketImpact: Brent crude ↑ to $107.31/bbl; WTI ↑ to $102.34/bbl; energy stocks ↑; inflation and rate-hike fears weigh on broader equities

topStories.headline: Nikkei 225 tumbles 4% to six-week low as SoftBank and chip stocks crater
topStories.summary: Japan's benchmark closed down ~4% in a broad selloff driven by the AI slowdown shock and surging oil prices; SoftBank fell 12%, Kioxia hit limit-down, and Advantest shed 4.5%.
topStories.marketImpact: 9984.T ↓ 12%; 6966.T ↓ limit-down (~8.6%); 6857.T ↓ 4.5%; 8035.T ↓ 2.6%; BOJ rate-hike expectations ↑ on energy-driven inflation

topStories.headline: Fed meets Tuesday–Wednesday; futures price 85% chance of 25bp hike to 3.75–4.00%
topStories.summary: The FOMC convenes its September 15–16 meeting with markets firmly expecting a 25bp hike following Chair Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech and an above-consensus August core CPI of 0.3%.
topStories.marketImpact: US equities ↓ on rate-hike pressure; US 10Y yield ↑ to 4.98%; USD firm; real estate and rate-sensitive sectors ↓

topStories.headline: Bank of Japan to raise rates September 18; 93% of watchers forecast a hike
topStories.summary: BOJ Governor Ueda signaled strong urgency for a September hike driven by oil-driven inflation and yen weakness, with a Bloomberg survey showing 93% of BOJ watchers expect the move.
topStories.marketImpact: JPY watch ↑; Japanese bond yields ↑; adds to global monetary tightening narrative; rate-sensitive sectors ↓

topStories.headline: Beijing injects ¥360bn into state banks but CSI300 still falls 1.6% on global risk-off
topStories.summary: China announced RMB 360 billion ($54bn) in capital injections into major state-owned banks and insurers to serve as long-term equity investors, but global risk sentiment dominated and Chinese equities declined.
topStories.marketImpact: State bank stocks watch; CSI300 ↓ 1.6%; Shanghai Composite ↓ to ~3,888; 9988.HK and 0700.HK ↓; China data dump later this week in focus

topStories.headline: August core CPI beats at 0.3%, payrolls add 162K — cementing Fed hike case
topStories.summary: US August core CPI rose 0.3% (above 0.2% consensus) and headline came in at 0.4%; non-farm payrolls beat expectations at 162K with wage growth slowing to 3.1%, reinforcing the case for a rate hike this week.
topStories.marketImpact: Rate-hike probability ↑ to 85%; bond yields ↑; growth stocks ↓; USD ↑

companiesToWatch.name: SoftBank Group
companiesToWatch.reason: Largest external OpenAI backer fell 12% as the IPO delay and AI safety narrative directly undermine its core investment thesis ahead of an expected BOJ rate hike.

companiesToWatch.name: Kioxia Holdings
companiesToWatch.reason: Japan's leading NAND flash memory chipmaker hit the limit-down circuit breaker as AI development slowdown fears threaten the memory demand cycle that drove its recent surge.

companiesToWatch.name: NVIDIA
companiesToWatch.reason: Premier AI chip designer is the central bellwether for the AI trade and faces direct headwinds if frontier model development actually slows across the industry.

companiesToWatch.name: Exxon Mobil
companiesToWatch.reason: Key beneficiary as Brent crude crosses $107 following the Saudi pipeline shutdown; a prolonged closure could deliver meaningful margin tailwinds for major US oil producers.

quickHits: MSCI Asia Pacific equities index declined 0.5% with broad losses across Japan and South Korea. (Bloomberg)
Taiyo Yuden fell 8.3% in Tokyo, amplifying the AI-linked semiconductor sector rout. (Bloomberg)
Anthropic expected to begin marketing its own IPO as early as mid-October 2026. (Fortune)
China's August data dump (industrial output, retail sales, house prices) due later this week — key read on stimulus efficacy. (Reuters)
